It specifies that a claim must be submitted in writing within 60 days of the date of loss and includes a list of documents that must be provided to assess the claim. The policy also states that the insurer will pay the claim within 60 days of receiving the required documents, unless the claim is related to the insolvency of the counterparty, in which case the payment will be made within 90 days of receiving the required documents.

Bottom line: To file a claim, the insured must submit a written claim within 60 days of the date of loss and provide specific documents as outlined in the policy. The insurer will pay the claim within 60 days of receiving the required documents, except in cases related to insolvency where the payment will be made within 90 days.

24.question: What specific situations or conditions are excluded from coverage under this critical illness policy?
24.ground_truth: The policy excludes coverage if the critical illness is caused or aggravated by any of the following: diagnosis, hospitalization, or treatment of a listed critical illness within 90 days of the policy’s start or reinstatement; any pre‑existing disease diagnosed within 36 months (or for which medical advice/treatment was received within 48 months) before the policy’s commencement or reinstatement; illnesses due to an external congenital defect diagnosed before age 18; suicide, attempted suicide, or intentional self‑inflicted injury; the life insured being under the influence of non‑prescribed drugs, alcohol, narcotics, or psychotropic substances; war, invasion, hostilities, civil war, rebellion, terrorist activity, revolution, riots, civil commotion, strikes, or industrial action; and participation by the life assured in a criminal or unlawful act.

Critical Illness means illness, the signs or symptoms of which first commence more than 90 days following the Issue

either the first diagnosis of any of the following illnesses or first performance of any of the covered surgeries stated 
below:

A malignant tumor characterized by the uncontrolled growth and spread of malignant cells with invasion and 
destruction of normal tissues. This diagnosis must be supported by histological evidence of malignancy. The term 
cancer includes leukemia, lymphoma and sarcoma. 
The following are excluded: 
 All tumors which are histologically described as carcinoma in situ, benign, pre-malignant, borderline 
malignant, low malignant potential, neoplasm of unknown behavior, or non-invasive, including but not 
limited to: Carcinoma in situ of breasts, Cervical dysplasia CIN-1, CIN - 2 and CIN-3. 
 Any non-melanoma skin carcinoma unless there is evidence of metastases to lymph nodes or beyond; 
 Malignant melanoma that has not caused invasion beyond the epidermis; 
 All tumors of the prostate unless histologically classified as having a Gleason score greater than 6 or 
having progressed to at least clinical TNM classification T2N0M0 
 All Thyroid cancers histologically classified as T1N0M0 (TNM Classification) or below; 
 Chronic lymphocytic leukaemia less than RAI stage 3 
 Non-invasive papillary cancer of the bladder histologically described as TaN0M0 or of a lesser 
classification, 
 All Gastro-Intestinal Stromal Tumors histologically classified as T1N0M0 (TNM Classification) or below 
and with mitotic count of less than or equal to 5/50 HPFs;

muscle as a result of inadequate blood supply to the relevant area. The diagnosis for Myocardial Infarction should 
be evidenced by all of the following criteria:

 A rise in cardiac biomarkers or Troponin T or I in absence of overt ischemic heart disease OR following 
an intra-arterial cardiac procedure.

68.question: What documents are required to file a death benefit claim and within what time frame must the claim be intimated under this policy?
68.ground_truth: The claimant must submit (i) a First Information Report, Inquest and Final Investigation Report attested by the jurisdictional police official, (ii) a Post Mortem Report attested by the concerned officials, and (iii) bank account details of the claimant with IFSC code (payment will be made by NEFT). The claim must be intimated to the Company within 90 days of the date of death, though delays beyond the claimant’s control may be condoned.

b. The active concealment of a fact by the insured having knowledge or belief of the fact;  
c. Any other act fitted to deceive; and  
d. Any such act or omission as the law specifically declares to be fraudulent.
